title: Petition for Pardon

signers.label: Approving Judge/Justice
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval -- not part of the intake handoff flow.

notes: Built from Bar Procedures Section 2H. A minimum of 6 months must have elapsed since arrest. A lawyer is required. Fee ranges from $100,000 to $500,000. Unlike expungement, pardons are for capital crimes only and always require a hearing before a Justice.

fields.label: CID
fields.prompt: Use /cid in city. This will add your CID to your clipboard. Paste that in here please.

fields.label: Lawyer
fields.prompt: You need a lawyer for this. Who is representing you? Type their full name.

fields.label: Date of Arrest
fields.prompt: What date were you arrested? Important: at least 6 months must have passed since this date.

fields.label: Date of Conviction
fields.prompt: What date were you found guilty of the charge(s)?

fields.label: Convicted By
fields.prompt: Which court convicted you? (e.g. San Andreas District Court, Supreme Court — if you're not sure, type "District Court".)

fields.label: Charge(s) Subject to Pardon
fields.prompt: Which specific charge(s) are you asking to be pardoned for? These should be capital crimes (the most serious kind). List them clearly.

fields.label: Personal Statement
fields.prompt: Tell us why you deserve a pardon. What have you done since your conviction to turn things around? This is your chance to explain — be honest.

fields.label: Character Witnesses & Evidence of Reform
fields.prompt:
List people who can vouch for you (character witnesses) and any evidence that shows you've changed. Examples:
- A business owner who employs you
- A doctor or government official who knows you
- Community service you've done
Include their names and what they can confirm about you.

fields.label: Weapons License Reinstatement Requested
fields.prompt: If your pardon is approved, do you want your weapons license back? (You'll still need to visit a police officer in person to pick it up.)

fields.label: Hearing Held
fields.note: Pardons always require a hearing, but this field records whether the hearing took place as scheduled.

fields.label: Fee Assessed
fields.note: Set by the Judge/Justice on approval -- ranges from $100,000 to $500,000 depending on the number and severity of charges.

fields.label: Approving Judge/Justice
fields.note: Rendered in cursive. Filled in by the bot when a Judge/Justice approves the pardon -- never asked of the applicant.
